item.title: Utah clinches spot in Big 12 Championship Game, here's how to buy tickets
item.description: After a day of upsets across college football, not only is Utah the only undefeated team left in the FBS, but the Utes are headed to the Big 12 Championship Game. Utah poured it on late to defeat TCU 38-17 late on Saturday night, moving to 11-0 and locking up the team's spot in the final Big 12 title game. The Power 4 conferences are eliminating the conference championships starting in 2027 in order for the College Football Playoff to expand to 24 teams. SHOP: Utah 2026 Big 12 Championship Game tickets While Utah's championship game opponent is still to be decided, the Utes will play either Texas Tech or BYU for the conference's automatic bid to the CFP, Utah fans can book their tickets for Texas . The Big 12 Championship Game will be played at the world-famous AT&T Stadium, home of the Dallas Cowboys, and tickets are already available . Here's everything you need to know. Shop Utah Big 12 Championship Game tickets Big 12 Conference Championship Game ticket prices As of publication, the cheapest ticket to attend the last Big 12 Championship Game is $177 . If you want a close-up view of AT&T Stadium, Hall of Fame seating at the lower level starts at only $275 in Section 148. Big 12 Conference Championship Game information When : Friday, Dec. 4 Where : AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas What time : 8 p.m. EST Tickets : Starting at $177 TV channel : ABC Utah Big 12 Championship game opponent Utah will either take on Texas Tech or BYU in the Big 12 Championship game. If Texas Tech defeats TCU on Thanksgiving, the Red Raiders will lock their spot against Utah. If TCU upsets Tech, BYU will have a chance to earn their place in the title game with a win against Cincinnati. When is the Big 12 Conference Championship game? The Big 12 Conference Championship Game is scheduled to take place on Friday, Dec. 4 at 8 p.m. EST. Where is the Big 12 Conference Championship Game? For the 10th consecutive year, the Big 12 Conference Championship Game will be played at AT&T Stadium in Arlington, Texas. item.title: Luck turns around for Golden Knights in shootout win over Jets
item.description: Nov 21, 2026; Winnipeg, Manitoba, CAN; Vegas Golden Knights center William Karlsson (71) score the winning goal in the shoot out on Winnipeg Jets goaltender Stuart Skinner (74) at Canada Life Centre. WINNIPEG—Heading back on the road, the Vegas Golden Knights needed any sort of momentum to get their season back on track. Sitting in second place in the Pacific Division by a comfortable margin, the Golden Knights were hardly in danger of losing their place in the standings. However, four straight losses to close out a five-game homestand undoubtedly left a sour taste in the mouths of players, coaches and fans alike. Between the loss to the last-place Vancouver Canucks, three losses last regulation and two straight third-period collapses against the Dallas Stars, the Golden Knights were in need of anything to stem the tide against them. Now on a road trip that will go beyond Thanksgiving, the Golden Knights finally got a break from their recent stretch of hard luck, securing a 5-4 shootout victory over the Winnipeg Jets to snap their losing streak. The Jets would force the Golden Knights on the back foot from the opening shot, as captain Adam Lowry would deflect Elias Salomonsson’s shot past Carter Hart to open the scoring in favor of the home side. However, the Golden Knights would come roaring back, starting with a clean faceoff win from Jack Eichel leading to a quick shot from Brett Howden that Winnipeg goaltender Stuart Skinner was unable to see. Less than 90 seconds later, Trevor Connelly and Mitch Marner continued to showcase their impressive chemistry, with the latter collecting a pass from the former and eventually potting in his own rebound for Vegas’ first lead of the night. The lead would not last through the end of the first period, as Eichel would cough up the puck in the neutral zone in the final minutes to lead to a tying goal from Jets rookie forward Viggo Bjorck. In the second period, controversy would strike during a Golden Knights power play when the net would come off its moorings before Tomas Hertl’s shot made it in. However, the referees would rule that Victor Olofsson was knocked into the net by Jets forward Alex Iafallo, counting the goal in favor of Vegas. The Winnipeg crowd’s vitriol would quickly turn into euphoria, as forward Mark Scheifele would pass Jets legend Dale Hawerchuk on the franchise’s all-time record with his 380th goal to tie the game at three. Kyle Connor would push the Jets back into the lead but, with less than four minutes remaining, a smart play from Hertl would give Ivan Barbashev time and space in the slot to sink a perfect shot past Skinner to push the Golden Knights to overtime for the third straight game. Despite some struggles, Hart would settle in with some key saves in the third period and overtime to preserve a point and keep the Golden Knights in it. Then, Hart would stop shots from Scheifele and Connor in the shootout, giving William Karlsson the chance to beat Skinner with a nifty deke. Despi

item.title: Tornike Kvaratskhelia: Man United battling Arsenal, Chelsea for Georgian winger
item.description: Tornike Kvaratskhelia: Man United battling Arsenal, Chelsea for Georgian winger Manchester United’s pursuit of a talented young winger, who is fast earning admirers across the continent, is unlikely to be a walk in the park. The Red Devils were keen to bolster the left-forward role over the summer, but their failure to offload Marcus Rashford , who returned from a fruitful loan spell at Barcelona, perhaps hurt their plans. The Englishman has failed to replicate last season’s form and the Premier League giants have lacked threat on the wings. With Matheus Cunha hardly faring any better, there has been talk of further reinforcements for the position at the turn of the year. While United will be looking for an immediate fix for the position, they are also likely to have an eye out for the future. INEOS have targeted several talented young footballers since their arrival in 2024 to build a backbone for the future and it now appears that they have unearthed another gem, this time in Georgia. Page 1 of 4 1 2 3 4 United among clubs eyeing Tornike Kvaratskhelia According to TEAMtalk , United are among the clubs keeping a close watch on highly-rated Georgian youngster Tornike Kvaratskhelia. The report states: “Premier League champions Arsenal have joined the growing list of clubs monitoring highly-rated Georgian youngster Tornike Kvaratskhelia, the younger brother of Paris Saint-Germain superstar Khvicha Kvaratskhelia, TEAMtalk can exclusively reveal.” “His emergence has attracted considerable attention from some of Europe’s biggest clubs, with TEAMtalk having previously revealed that Chelsea and Tottenham have both scouted the youngster.” “Manchester City, Manchester United, Liverpool, Brighton and Aston Villa have also been keeping tabs on his development.” The report confirms that PSG, Juventus, Napoli and Atalanta are also keeping the 16-year-old under close watch, while Bayern Munich, RB Leipzig and Borussia Dortmund are in the race as well. Who is Tornike Kvaratskhelia? Tornike Kvaratskhelia is currently part of Georgian club Dinamo Tbilisi’s academy, but such has been his rise with the youth sides that he has already broken into the senior side, registering 16 appearances this season. However, TEAMtalk point out that the left-winger, who will turn 17 in February 2027, “would not be eligible to move to England until January 2028 at the earliest under current regulations.” That has not stopped his suitors though, with clubs keen to lay groundwork to get ahead of the competition in the race. Fast, skilful and equipped with a venomous shot, Tornike is ready to move out of the shadows of his older brother Khvicha , and carve a reputation of his own. While United missed out on the PSG ace, they could make amends by securing the services of the teenager to sort out their left-wing issues. item.title: New chair Faulkner can turn around WRU - Davies
item.description: Lyndon Faulkner officially takes over as WRU chair in Decemeber [Huw Evans Picture Agency] Former Wales captain Jonathan Davies says new Welsh Rugby Union (WRU) chairman Lyndon Faulkner is the man to turn Welsh rugby around. The former Newport and Pontypool forward, who will take over from Richard Collier-Keywood , attends his first WRU annual general meeting (AGM) on Sunday. He has already promised to review everything including the controversial plan to cut a men's professional side by 2028, Faulkner has forged a highly successful business career in the United States of America. The 66-year-old also has a Welsh rugby background as the nephew of former Wales rugby prop Charlie Faulkner, who was yesterday inducted into World Rugby's hall of fame alongside Bobby Windsor and Graham Price - the famed Pontypool front-row. Former Wales fly-half Davies, who called for the WRU board to resign before Faulkner's appointment, believes the new will chair galvanise Welsh rugby off the field when he officially starts his role next month. “I believe the chair is a good guy and he has the opportunity to change things and he will make them,” said Davies. “He is a successful businessman, but he is a rugby man." Davies has described the problems at the WRU as similar to Manchester United. “When I look at Man United, I also look at the WRU," Davies told BBC 5 Live sport. "When Man United changed and brought the bankers in there was no football knowledge and the same has happened in Welsh rugby." The former Wales captain said decisions that have been made by the union have been purely financial, and not rugby ones. “Lyndon is the right man and will make the necessary changes in the WRU to give these guys a better platform," Davies added. “It’s not going to happen overnight and if we don‘t make these changes we will be in tier two for a long time.” WRU names businessman Faulkner as new chairman WRU is to blame for current mess - Davies Jonathan Davies is a former dual-code rugby international [Huw Evans Picture Agency] Davies believes the WRU needs to help the players who earlier this month inspired the nation with a first victory against New Zealand in 73 years, a match played in front of just over 55,000 fans. “I heard Dewi Lake say something before the New Zealand game and I felt really sorry for the players," said Davies. “He said because the attendance was low that was down to them. I felt sad the players felt like that. “[Welsh rugby] is a real side show at the moment with the players taking the brunt of it and Dewi and Jac [Morgan] have gone to Gloucester where, from what I have heard, they have changed the culture and are two great guys. “Nobody blames the players for where they are, it’s the WRU’s job. “The New Zealand win shows what the players are capable of given the right platform.” Prem opens registration for expansion to 12 teams RFU boss confirms WRU Anglo-Welsh league approach Davies backs Anglo-Welsh option Faulkner has also indicated he is a fan of

item.title: Five quick takeaways from Las Vegas GP
item.description: Motorsport photo Las Vegas gets the pack race it craved In America's artificial entertainment capital, F1 put the most artificial and entertaining spectacle. How fitting. The yo-yo racing from the early days of the 2026 season was back on full display, with the lack of electric energy available on the Strip's mile long straight bring back battery driven overtaking. For a while it felt like we were watching the Indy 500, with the top cars trading the lead without being able to break away from the rest of the pack. It led to numerous position changes and plenty of wheel-to-wheel races, much to the delight of the soldout crowd and event officials. It's certainly not for everyone, but you can't deny there was something to watch. And it was certainly a much better watch than the Madring's Spanish Grand Prix. - Fil Cleeren Ferrari in meltdown as Hamilton and Leclerc clash again Ferrari came into Las Vegas with two clear objectives: Try to win (naturally) and try to lockdown second place in the F1 world constructors’ championship. While the first target was going to be a tall order given the Scuderia’s lack of engine punch on the long Las Vegas straights, not losing more than 10 points to Red Bull was entirely realistic to second P2. But then the unsolved objectives reared up once again. Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc seem unable to race each other as team-mates. That much was evident in Mexico as they cost each other the win, but clear-the-air talks were meant to have solved all that in Brazil. Two weeks later, it is worse than ever. Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari Hamilton vented his fury at Leclerc for fighting him in the pack during the opening act of the Las Vegas GP slipstreaming, battery-boosting ‘race’, with the Monegasque on the scene when he ran off the road and kept ahead of Lando Norris to pick up a 10-second penalty. After having to serve his penalty a lap into the safety car period, in order not to hold up Leclerc who was behind him, the pair re-engaged their on-track disagreements and it was Leclerc’s turn to make the error. But this time he clattered into his team-mate, spinning Hamilton around, and earning himself a 10s penalty. Whatever was said in Brazil clearly went in one ear and out of the other. - Haydn Cobb Verstappen vs Russell: Max wins again An old rivalry was reignited in Las Vegas this weekend following an incident during FP3, the session that usually generates the fewest headlines over a Grand Prix weekend. Verstappen and Russell went wheel-to-wheel as if they were fighting for position in a race, and the Briton didn't hold back when speaking to the media afterwards, claiming that his rival "thinks he is more important than everyone else" and that "someone needs to put him in his place". (Photo by Matthew Stockman/Getty Images) Getty The Golden State Warriors have been in a slump since losing Stephen Curry to a right oblique injury nearly two weeks ago. The Warriors have lost five in a row heading into Sunday’s matchup against the Boston Celtics at the Chase Center. Despite their losing streak, Yaxel Lendeborg remains in the spotlight as he shows more vulnerability and emotion amid a rough stretch. Lendeborg is still putting up numbers, averaging 16.0 points, 7.6 rebounds, 3.0 assists, 1.2 steals and 1.0 blocks during their losing streak. However, he’s shooting just 33.3 percent from the field and 20.0 percent from 3-point range. Steve Kerr’s Blunt Advice for Yaxel Lendeborg Getty Yaxel Lendeborg #1 of the Golden State Warriors looks on during the second half against the Memphis Grizzlies at FedExForum on November 19, 2026 in Memphis, Tennessee. Speaking to reporters after Sunday’s practice, Golden State Warriors head coach Steve Kerr was asked about the current conversation about athletes being more open about their emotions and showing their vulnerable side to everyone. Kerr supports all athletes who are not afraid of their emotions, especially Yaxel Lendeborg, but he also shared blunt advice for his rookie forward. “I think in general, it’s a really good thing,” Kerr said via Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle . “But it can’t be missed shot, bad game, show vulnerability.” Asked Steve Kerr, in context of a couple questions on Yaxel Lendeborg, what he thought on broader conversation on modern-day athletes being more open with emotion, vulnerability. “I think in general, it’s a really good thing. India vs. New Zealand 1st Test, Day 4 Live Score & Updates Welcome to CricketNews.com's live coverage of the 1st Test between India and New Zealand at Basin Reserve in Wellington. Day 4, Stumps: New Zealand 119/2 as Devon Conway and Rachin Ravindra dig in New Zealand closed on 119 for 2, still 233 behind, with eight wickets in hand and a full day to survive. Prasidh Krishna removed first-innings centurion Henry Nicholls for 31, with Dhruv Jurel diving forward at short leg to scoop up a one-handed catch off the inside edge. Devon Conway is unbeaten on 59 from 137 balls for his 14th Test fifty, having taken 13 deliveries to get off the mark, with Rachin Ravindra at 27 not out from 72. The pair have added an unbroken 59 for the third wicket, and New Zealand's control percentage rose from 81.6 in the first 30 overs of the innings to 98.9 in the 15 after that. Day 4, Tea: New Zealand 33/1 as Jasprit Bumrah takes a wicket in his second ball Jasprit Bumrah didn't waste time to put pressure on the Kiwis as he dismissed Tom Latham in the very first over of the second innings. New Zealand has struggled to put runs on the board, as the duo of Devon Conway and Henry Nicholls continue their attempt to anchor their innings. Day 4, 2nd session: India declares on 720/9 with a lead of 352 runs India declared 720 for 9, the highest team total ever made in New Zealand, passing the hosts' 715/6d against Bangladesh at Hamilton in 2019. It is also the highest innings total against New Zealand anywhere, bettering the West Indies' 660/5d at this ground in 1995. Dhruv Jurel was the sixth Indian batter past fifty in the innings, making 78 off 79 balls with seven fours and a six before Glenn Phillips had him stumped off the last ball India faced. Washington Sundar fell for 24 off 26 to a return catch off Rachin Ravindra, while Anshul Kamboj had earlier gone for 38 off 42 and Akash Deep struck two sixes in a 13 off five balls. item.title: F1 Las Vegas GP: Max Verstappen wins thriller as Ferraris come to blows
item.description: Motorsport photo Max Verstappen won an eventful Las Vegas Grand Prix, holding off both Mercedes as Formula 1’s novel ‘yo-yo’ racing returned – with no Silver Arrow on the eventual podium. With qualifying pacesetter Kimi Antonelli taking a five-place grid penalty for exceeding his engine allocation, Max Verstappen inherited pole position and retained the lead from George Russell at the start with an unchanged top five: Lando Norris, Isack Hadjar and Arvid Lindblad followed – though Hadjar swiftly found a way past the McLaren on lap one. The only top-10 driver starting on mediums, Antonelli lost two spots to the Alpines at lights out, finding himself eighth ahead of the Ferraris, who were out in Q2 – though Franco Colapinto would soon collapse from seventh to 10th, then out of the points-paying positions. Verstappen couldn’t break away from Russell, and the Briton briefly snatched the lead away on lap two before the Dutchman immediately responded. Russell couldn’t attack the leader again and was instead overtaken by the sister Red Bull car. Now it was these two trading places… until Lindblad remarkably overtook Norris and Russell in quick succession, even though he could not hold the Mercedes off. Meanwhile, Hadjar was pressuring Verstappen for the lead but had to deal with Russell’s attacks. “We need to not lose time as a team,” the Frenchman was told. “Can he stop defending?” he inquired about his team-mate’s driving. Hadjar briefly took the lead soon after, though he dropped to third moments later. On lap 10, the top 10 cars still lay within four seconds. Russell momentarily retook the lead (again) as Pierre Gasly fought to third, though he couldn’t hold off Hadjar for long. There were no changes among the top four for a moment, but Norris’ collapse continued as he ended up outside the top 10. Russell took the lead back on laps 14 and 18, but this was again Turn 14 moves with Verstappen sweeping back past on the start/finish straight. The second time, Hadjar snuck by in second. Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes Max Verstappen, Red Bull Racing, George Russell, Mercedes New world champion Antonelli climbed to fourth on lap 17, recovering from eighth on lap one. Meanwhile, the Ferraris were battling both their rivals and among themselves for seventh place. Charles Leclerc called on his team-mate to “be careful with this squeezing”; Lewis Hamilton said the sister car should “back the f**k off” – and copped a 10-second penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage. The safety car was called into action on lap 19 as Sergio Perez spun Rafael Camara around and broke his front suspension; nearly all cars pitted straightaway – Red Bull’s double-stack allowing Russell to snuck back into second – but not Lewis Hamilton, due to the seven-time world champion’s track position ahead of his team-mate and his 10-second grid penalty. item.title: Harpring scores 20, No. 24 North Carolina women pull away from Alabama
item.description: CHARLOTTE, NORTH CAROLINA - NOVEMBER 08: Guard Kate Harpring #11 of the North Carolina Tar Heels brings the ball up court during the second half of the 2026 Ally Tip Off against the South Carolina Gamecocks at Spectrum Center on November 08, 2026 in Charlotte, North Carolina. (Photo by Matt Kelley/Getty Images) Getty Images KISSIMMEE, Fla. (AP) — Kate Harpring scored 20 points, Achol Akot added 16 and No. 24 North Carolina used two runs in the second half on Saturday to defeat Alabama 78-64 at the WBCA Showcase. The 16th and final lead change came during a 13-0 run to end the third quarter. Harping hit a pair of 3s and a 3 from Laila Hull at the buzzer gave the Tar Heels a 60-50 lead. Hull hit another 3 after the Crimson Tide got with seven points midway through the fourth quarter, starting a 10-0 run capped by a 3-pointer from Nyla Brooks that made it 76-59 with less than 2 minutes to go. Brooks added 14 points for the Tar Heels (4-2), who went 12 of 28 from the 3-point line and shot 46% overall to overcome a 4 of 11 showing at the foul line. Ace Austin had 15 points for the Crimson Tide (6-2). Alayna West added 13 points off the bench and Aaliyah Roberson scored 11. The Tar Heels scored the first nine points of the game but the Crimson Tide scrapped back to lead 38-36 at the half. Alabama had three turnovers and missed two shots but then made five straight to get back in the game and there were 11 lead changes before the break. Up next Alabama: Host Louisiana-Monroe on Tuesday. North Carolina: Host Gardner-Webb on Tuesday.

item.title: Celtics handed third straight loss in last-minute loss to Kings
item.description: The Boston Celtics were back in action on Saturday night, looking to snap a two-game skid and did so with a much different lineup thatn their normal go-to starters. Jayson Tatum, Derrick White, and Mitchell Robinson all missed the game, which allowed for Payton Pritchard, Hugo Gonzalez, and Sam Hauser to crrack the starting lineup, and this game against Sacramento had plenty of challenges. Just as they did in their last game, the Celtics jumped out to an early first half lead, but a rough third quarter allowed the Kings to get back into the game, and took the game down to the wire. In the end, it was the second half which led to the demise of the Celtics, and they'll need to figure it out quickly on the first night of a back-to-back for the weekend. Here's a quick recap of the Celtics coming up short against the Sacramento Kings , leading to their third straight loss. Final score: Sacramento Kings 97, Boston Celtics 96 Keys to the game: Different looking lineup: With multiple starters out for the game, it allowed for not only new starters but for others to step up with more opportunities, which is what veteran Mike Conley did throughout the night. Conley had 19 points off the bench for Boston, while Neemias Queta and Sam Hauser combined for 29 points between them to help the starting unit. Payton Pritchard and Paul George struggled in this game, which hurt the flow of the offense without Jayson Tatum and Derrick White. Big third quarter for Kings : Highlight of the game: Keegan Murray gets the tip-in to drop for the game winning score KEEGAN MURRAY SOARS IN FOR THE PUTBACK TO WIN IT FOR THE KINGS 😤 pic.twitter.com/ac6gXagBGv — ClutchPoints (@ClutchPoints) November 22, 2026 What's next: @ Golden State Warriors, Sunday, November 22, 8:30PM ET This article originally appeared on Celtics Wire: Celtics handed third straight loss in last-minute loss to Kings

item.title: No. 1 Georgia football reacts to win at No. 21 South Carolina
item.description: The Georgia Bulldogs come into this game understanding that they would receive everything South Carolina could give them. Well, the first half of the game the Gamecocks did exactly that. The score was 10-6 with the Bulldogs leading going into the break. South Carolina had some confidence going and they had some momentum. The Bulldogs have been going into the half up by a big margin on most teams this season. The Gamecocks had done something most teams on Georgia's schedule haven't and that's hold them to just 10 points at halftime. The Bulldogs have outscored their opponents by 201 points combined this season heading into halftime. The second half, the Georgia Bulldogs put their foots on the gas just a bit more while the Gamecocks were basically idle. The Bulldogs exploded for 241 yards in the second half and averaging 7.1 yards per play. Georgia held South Carolina to under 100 yards total in the second half. The Bulldogs outscored the Gamecocks 24-0 in the second half and 31-0 after trailing 6-3. Georgia football reacts to win at South Carolina Kirby Smart reacts to Bulldogs' performance Kirby Smart was proud of how his team responded when it came to going into the half with a close game with South Carolina. The Bulldogs came out in the second half and played physical and fast embracing any challenge that was facing them. "This is a good football team... our guys embrace that challenge... Our guys responded, I'm so proud of this University," Smart said. Kirby Smart after the South Carolina victory was very locked in when it comes to the week to week challenges that come their way. The Bulldogs have another rivalry game awaiting them next week against the Georgia Tech Yellow Jackets . After being asked about the SEC championship game and what it means appearing in six straight, Smart isn't looking ahead. Smart stated, "I would say, we got Georgia Tech next week, I'm smart enough to know what that means." The Bulldogs will gear up for their rival in an in-state battle. The Bulldogs will not take the Yellow Jackets lightly as they look to improve in all areas as usual. Gunner Stockton reacts to beating South Carolina Gunner Stockton made the plays that were needed to be made to help the Bulldogs pull away from the contest against the South Carolina Gamecocks . Stockton doesn't dismiss the challenge of being on the road in the SEC. "Anytime you win on the road, definitely in the SEC, it's a tough environment. They had a great home environment tonight. Definitely a game you dream of playing in and they have a great home crowd," Stockton said. The Bulldogs were able to figure out ways to provide some explosive plays and once they did, it really put South Carolina behind. Georgia exploded in the second half with those big plays and did what Georgia does and put the game away fairly quickly in the second half. item.title: Victor Wembanyama seemingly throws shade at other superstars with stat-padding comments
item.description: Victor Wembanyama seemingly throws shade at other superstars with stat-padding comments originally appeared on The Sporting News . Add The Sporting News as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Victor Wembanyama added another feather in his cap with his performance on Saturday night against the New Orleans Pelicans . It was a masterful performance for the San Antonio Spurs big man, posting 50 points, 18 rebounds, four steals, and five blocks. He did so in only 32 minutes, as the Spurs managed to pull away from the Pelicans in the second half. Wembanyama noted that he did not stat pad, which is often a discussion when it comes to having lofty numbers. Victor Wembanyama calls out stat pad discourse after another big game Across the NBA, there have been plenty of players who have gotten lofty numbers. This season, Wembanyama and Los Angeles Lakers superstar Luka Doncic are leading the MVP race because of their numbers, which has naturally led to people calling out potential stat padding. Wembanyama is definitely against that kind of discourse because he knows that he has been working hard. Even in the games played for less than 30 minutes, he had standout numbers, so those accusations do not have merit. MORE: Victor Wembanyama's case to be the premier MVP candidate this season There might be some players around the league that have been padding stats, which Wembanyama has alluded to. It is still a problem, but Victor definitely thinks that it is not on him. "It is very special, but unlike many of my peers, I'm not very good at stat-padding," Wembanyama said about his numbers after the game . "Maybe, I think that’s a question for you. The greats, they don’t think about that. I don’t think LeBron, Shai, Jokic, Doncic, I don’t think they think about that," Wembanyama followed up with a compliment to his fellow stars . While the initial comment looked like a bit of a slight against his fellow stars, it seems that he has singled out the likes of Gilgeous-Alexander, LeBron James, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander, and Nikola Jokic as players who do not pad their stats. item.title: 2027: Who speaks for the North as ACF crisis deepens?
item.description: By Ibrahim Hassan-Wuyo As the 2027 general elections draw closer, an increasingly important question is emerging in Northern Nigeria: Who speaks for the North, and whose position represents the collective interests of the region? The question has assumed greater significance amid the lingering leadership crisis in the Arewa Consultative Forum (ACF), one of the North’s longstanding socio-political platforms, and growing disagreements among prominent Northern politicians, elder statesmen and interest groups over the direction the region should take in the next general elections. For decades, the ACF provided an important platform for articulating Northern interests, engaging governments and promoting regional cohesion. However, its current internal disagreements, involving its Board of Trustees and National Executive Committee, have raised questions about its ability to provide the kind of unified regional leadership expected of it at a critical political moment. The dispute has reportedly degenerated into competing claims of authority, allegations of constitutional breaches and disagreements over the management of the organisation’s affairs. The development may create an opening for other political and socio-cultural platforms to occupy the space traditionally associated with the ACF. Indeed, the struggle over who represents Northern opinion became more apparent on Wednesday when the Arewa Emerging Elites Round Table challenged some prominent Northern figures over their criticism of President Bola Tinubu’s administration. At a press conference in Kaduna, the group, through its chairman, Abubakar A. Kurawa, faulted Dr Hakeem Baba-Ahmed, Dr Usman Bugaje, former Minister Adamu Maina Waziri and former National Health Insurance Scheme Executive Secretary, Prof Usman Yusuf, for what it described as presenting partisan political positions as the collective position of Northern Nigeria. In a briefing titled, Stop Hiding Naked Partisanship Behind the Sacred Robes of Arewa Eldership: You Do Not Speak for the North!, the organisation questioned the mandate under which the four personalities purportedly spoke for the region. It argued that neither previous public offices nor political prominence automatically conferred the authority to determine the political direction of the 19 Northern states. The group particularly questioned whether traditional rulers, religious leaders, youth organisations, professional associations, farmers, traders and ordinary citizens had been adequately consulted before positions were presented as representing the North. It also challenged the former public office holders to demonstrate their contributions to regional development, insisting that discussions about Northern leadership should go beyond political rhetoric to measurable achievements. item.title: Connor Bedard Facing Season-Ending Surgery
item.description: The Chicago Blackhawks are staring at season-ending surgery for their captain, Connor Bedard, according to initial reports. Getty Chicago Blackhawks captain Connor Bedard is expected to have shoulder surgery at some point next week. The news came from initial reports by insider Elliotte Friedman. There had been some debate earlier this week regarding the possibility of Bedard opting to rehab the injury versus surgery. With the decision being surgery, there’s a good chance that the issue is far too serious for rehab alone to solve it. Injury notes today: Connor Bedard shoulder surgery on Monday. Timeline to be delivered post-op Nathan MacKinnon updated to out 12 weeks Quinn Hughes sent home from road trip to be evaluated in Minnesota Elias Pettersson out tonight (upper body), needs further evaluation — Elliotte Friedman (@FriedgeHNIC) November 22, 2026 And as notable medical expert, Dr. Harjas Grewal noted a few days ago, the surgical option could mean Connor Bedard could be looking at a season-ending situation . Concern is a shoulder dislocation or subluxation (partial dislocation) for Bedard Timeline will depend on his stability, range of motion, strength and his MRI findings If can rehab, could be multiple weeks still but if surgery needed his season is over https://t.co/VYEzZuL1CJ — Dr. Harjas Grewal (@Harjas_Grewal) November 18, 2026 According to Friedman, Bedard will be having surgery on his right shoulder, a similar procedure to the one he had on his left shoulder, following a fall during a practice over the summer. That summer surgery caused Bedard to miss about three months. If that’s the same prognosis for Bedard this time around, a rough timeline could see the Blackhawks captain return around the end of February. The Blackhawks are already circling the drain this season. With Connor Bedard out for that long , it could pose a challenge that may be too much for the organization to overcome at this juncture. Blackhawks May Just Shut Connor Bedard Down for the Season Considering that the Blackhawks won’t likely have much to play for this season, the organization may choose to just shut down their captain for the entire season. Let’s war-game this out. If Connor Bedard is reaty to return at some point in mid to late February, the season could well be over for the Blackhawks by then. The team may be just playing out the string, potentially looking at yet another high draft pick at the end of the year. So, would it make sense to bring back Bedard for the last, say, six weeks or the season? The plan may be to get him back on the ice regardless of the standings just so that he can get some game action before the end of the year. Then again, why risk having Connor Bedard re-aggravate something or even risk rushing back to the ice too soon? Perhaps the line there might be to bring Bedard back if he’s ready. If he’s not, then there would be no point in rushing him back unless there’s a legitimate reason for him to return as soon as he’s ready. Chic

item.title: 'They couldn't live with it!' - Dominic Calvert-Lewin revels in Stamford Bridge rout as Chelsea crumble against Leeds United
item.description: Chelsea FC v Leeds United - Premier League 2026/27 - Getty Images Sport Dominic Calvert-Lewin urged his Leeds United team-mates to savour their first Stamford Bridge triumph since 1999 after dismantling Chelsea 4-1 in the Premier League. The in-form striker converted a crucial second-half penalty and insisted Xabi Alonso's hosts simply could not handle Leeds' relentless intensity. Calvert-Lewin relishes long-awaited Bridge triumph Dominic Calvert-Lewin called on Leeds United to savour their 4-1 Premier League demolition of Chelsea after helping the Whites secure their first victory at Stamford Bridge since 1999. The striker rattled home a pivotal second-half penalty between Noah Okafor's brace before substitute Brenden Aaronson added a stoppage-time fourth. Celebrations erupted inside the away end and visiting dressing room as Leeds climbed up to sixth in the table . "Great feeling," Calvert-Lewin said. "I think you can see it at the end, the way we celebrated it. It's always great to win in the Premier League, especially away from home in a place like Stamford Bridge, so I think you have to enjoy it." Relentless intensity overwhelms Alonso's Chelsea Leeds fell behind midway through the first half when Emmanuel Emegha fired Chelsea ahead on his full debut, only for Okafor to equalise within three minutes. Rather than fading after the interval, Daniel Farke's men stepped up their pressing, won a penalty when a shot struck Morgan Rogers high on the arm, and blew the Blues away. "We expected them to probably come out with a bit more of a reaction, and we started the second half exactly the same as we started the first, which was intensity," Calvert-Lewin explained. "I don't think they could live with it today, and that was reflected in the scoreline." Peak fitness fuels striker's confident streak Calvert-Lewin proved a constant aerial menace throughout the contest, rattling Emiliano Martinez's crossbar with an early header before dispatching his spot-kick into the bottom corner. Fresh from winning in Madrid with England during the international break, the forward credited his physical rhythm for his commanding display. "I'm feeling comfortable in my body at the moment and really enjoying my football," Calvert-Lewin revealed. "And for me, when I feel like that, going onto a football pitch, I feel like I can play against anybody, so I'm full of confidence at the moment. A great seven days and a great result coming back in." Momentum builds for top-six contenders The victory capped an unforgettable week for Calvert-Lewin and underlined Leeds' growing credentials under Farke as they moved into sixth place ahead of the weekend's remaining fixtures. With Okafor clinical in front of goal and the squad brimming with belief, Leeds carry formidable momentum into the busy winter schedule. For Chelsea, meanwhile, defeat leaves Alonso searching for answers before the Blues travel to Nottingham Forest next Friday night.

item.title: Spurs star Victor Wembanyama drops tough ‘stat padding’ declaration after dropping 50 on Pelicans
item.description: Cary Edmondson-Imagn Images Spurs star Victor Wembanyama drops tough ‘stat padding’ declaration after dropping 50 on Pelicans appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Victor Wembanyama put together one of the most dominant performances of the NBA season on Saturday night , but the San Antonio Spurs star refused to take himself too seriously afterward. Wembanyama erupted for 50 points, 19 rebounds, five blocks and four steals as the Spurs cruised to a 114-91 victory over the New Orleans Pelicans at Frost Bank Center. When asked during his postgame interview how special it was to reach such a rare threshold, the 22-year-old offered a playful jab at the rest of the league. “It is very special. But unlike many of my peers, I’m not very good at stat-padding. So, I haven’t reached it yet,” Wembanyama said, via the Spurs X account. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) "Unlike many of my peers, i'm not very good at statpadding" Victor Wembanyama after his 50-point outburst 😳 (via @spurs ) pic.twitter.com/kdNFR3BpYR — ClutchPoints (@ClutchPoints) November 22, 2026 The comment was classic Wembanyama, whose dry sense of humor has become a regular part of his postgame routine. He finished just one rebound shy of a 50-point, 20-rebound night. There was nothing padded about his numbers, though. Wembanyama shot an efficient 20-of-29 from the field, including 5-of-11 from beyond the arc, and San Antonio outscored New Orleans by 35 points with him on the floor. The Spurs led by as many as 29 points. The outing also cemented his place in the history books . Wembanyama became just the fourth player in NBA history with at least 50 points, 15 rebounds and five blocks in a game, joining Wilt Chamberlain, Anthony Davis and Bob McAdoo. He has now done it twice this month, after putting up 52 points, 24 rebounds and eight blocks against the Dallas Mavericks on Nov. 4. Wembanyama also joined David Robinson as the only players to record multiple 50-point, five-block games since blocks became an official stat in 1973-74. Stephon Castle added 19 points and hit five 3-pointers for the Spurs, while De’Aaron Fox dished out 10 assists. Jeremiah Fears paced the Pelicans with 29 points, and Jordan Poole scored 25. San Antonio improved to 14-3 with the victory and has won 12 of its last 13 games . If this is what Wembanyama looks like when he isn’t chasing numbers, the rest of the league should be worried about what happens when he actually tries. item.title: NFL Teams Urged to Make Major Arch Manning Move Despite Negatives
item.description: AUSTIN, TEXAS - NOVEMBER 21: Arch Manning #16 of the Texas Longhorns arrives prior to the game against the Arkansas Razorbacks at Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium on November 21, 2026 in Austin, Texas. (Photo by Tim Warner/Getty Images) Getty AUSTIN, TEXAS - NOVEMBER 21: Arch Manning #16 of the Texas Longhorns warms up before the game against the Arkansas Razorbacks at Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium on November 21, 2026 in Austin, Texas. (Photo by Tim Warner/Getty Images) Getty AUSTIN, TEXAS - NOVEMBER 21: Arch Manning #16 of the Texas Longhorns rushes for a touchdown in the first quarter Christian Harrison #1 of the Arkansas Razorbacks at Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium on November 21, 2026 in Austin, Texas. (Photo by Tim Warner/Getty Images) Getty NFL teams searching for a quarterback should be willing to spend the first overall pick on Arch Manning, according to Skip Bayless. Even with the flaws Bayless sees in the Texas Longhorns quarterback’s game. The longtime commentator made his case on X on Nov. 21. He acknowledged Manning’s uneven play and questioned how he handles adversity. Still, Bayless believes his talent makes passing on him too great a risk. “If I needed a QB and had the first pick, I’d close one eye and take Arch, just on potential and bloodline,” Bayless wrote. If I needed a QB and had the first pick, I'd close one eye and take Arch, just on potential and bloodline. Yes, he can be scary inconsistent, overemotional and thin-skinned. Way too many INTs. But I've also seen so many throws & runs that would make me afraid not to take him. — Skip Bayless (@RealSkipBayless) November 21, 2026 Skip Bayless Backs Arch Manning Despite Turnover Concerns Getty AUSTIN, TEXAS – NOVEMBER 21: Arch Manning #16 of the Texas Longhorns warms up before the game against the Arkansas Razorbacks at Darrell K Royal-Texas Memorial Stadium on November 21, 2026 in Austin, Texas. (Photo by Tim Warner/Getty Images) Bayless surfaced an assessment of the problems he would accept with that choice. “Yes, he can be scary inconsistent, overemotional and thin-skinned. Way too many INTs,” he wrote. Those descriptions reflect Bayless’ judgment. His endorsement came with reservations about both Manning’s decisions and his response when things go wrong. The strongest part of his argument rested on what he has watched Manning do with his arm and legs. “But I’ve also seen so many throws & runs that would make me afraid not to take him,” Bayless added. That’s a big-time bet for a team holding the top pick. Bayless would accept the mistakes because he believes Manning’s best plays point toward a better NFL quarterback. His proposal also carries two conditions. Manning would have to enter the draft, and the team choosing first would need a passer. item.title: UNM Women Roll Past New Mexico State 71-50 to Claim In-State Showdown at The Pit
item.description: ALBUQUERQUE, N.M. (KRQE) –The University of New Mexico women's basketball team protected home court Tuesday, defeating in-state rival New Mexico State 71-50 at The Pit. The Lobos set the tone early, taking control out of the gate. But the Aggies made a push in the 1st half, led by Raina Tomasicka, who caught fire from beyond the arc. Tomasicka finished with 17 points off the bench to lead New Mexico State. UNM answered with a balanced offensive effort. Katie Duncan paced the Lobos with 14 points, including four three-pointers, while Mya Thompson contributed nine points, six assists and four rebounds. Mila Reynolds also returned to action, giving the Lobos another presence up front. Late in the game, Laila Abdurraqib showed off her court vision with a no-look pass to Leonor Peixinho for the finish. The 21-point victory keeps the bragging rights in Albuquerque as the Lobos turn their attention to their next matchup. UNM returns to The Pit Tuesday to host Eastern Kentucky. item.title: Verstappen survives absolute Las Vegas GP madness as Ferrari civil war erupts
item.description: Max Verstappen emerged victorious from an extraordinary Las Vegas Grand Prix , holding off a relentless challenge from Kimi Antonelli in a race packed with dramatic overtakes, fierce battles and controversy. However, the biggest drama unfolded at Ferrari, where tensions between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc erupted into a collision that sent the seven-time world champion spinning. Verstappen maintained his lead at the start of the Las Vegas Grand Prix , fending off Russell to avoid a repeat of the tensions that had emerged between the two during practice earlier in the weekend. However, the opening laps were far from straightforward, with several battles unfolding throughout the field. Behind the leading pair, Lando Norris came under immediate pressure from Isack Hadjar in the fight for third place. The McLaren driver initially managed to keep his rival behind, but Hadjar eventually found a way past to move into the top three. Further back, Kimi Antonelli endured a difficult start, losing two positions on the opening lap. Both Ferrari drivers, meanwhile, made progress through the field, overtaking Nico Hulkenberg's Audi before Lewis Hamilton managed to get ahead of teammate Charles Leclerc. At the front, Russell briefly took the lead from Verstappen, only for the Red Bull driver to reclaim first place along the start-finish straight as the Mercedes ran out of electrical deployment. Photo: Race Pictures Photo: Race Pictures The action intensified between laps four and five, when Russell and Hadjar became embroiled in a fierce battle, exchanging positions several times as neither driver was willing to back down. Arvid Lindblad also joined the fight, producing an impressive overtaking move around the outside of Turn 2. However, the Racing Bulls driver was unable to consolidate his advantage and eventually surrendered the position. In the following laps, Hadjar emerged as a genuine threat to his teammate's lead, with Russell's pressure from behind adding further intensity to the battle. However, Red Bull instructed their drivers over team radio to work together and avoid fighting each other on track. On lap 10, Russell overtook both Hadjar and Verstappen to take the lead, only for the Dutchman to fight back shortly afterwards and reclaim first place. The race developed into an increasingly strategic contest, with electrical deployment and slipstreaming proving decisive as the top ten remained tightly bunched together. The two Ferrari drivers were also involved in a fierce battle, with Hamilton and Leclerc both overtaking Norris before turning their attention to each other. Meanwhile, Franco Colapinto made further progress through the field, managing to overtake both McLarens. Hamilton's race was dealt a major blow when the stewards handed him a 10-second penalty for leaving the track and gaining an advantage during his battle with Norris. item.title: ‘I Think That’s Premature’ — Mike Florio Reacts to ESPN Insider’s Surprising Claim That Puka Nacua’s Rams Stint Is ‘Probably Over’
item.description: ‘I Think That’s Premature’ — Mike Florio Reacts to ESPN Insider’s Surprising Claim That Puka Nacua’s Rams Stint Is ‘Probably Over’ Puka Nacua’s future in Los Angeles has suddenly become one of the NFL’s most polarizing storylines. After MCL surgery on Nov. 17, a reported four-to-five-month recovery timeline and a three-game suspension under the Personal Conduct Policy, people are wondering whether the star receiver has played his final snap for the Rams. ESPN insider Jeremy Fowler believes Nacua’s time in Los Angeles is “probably over,” but Pro Football Talk’s Mike Florio isn’t convinced and thinks the Rams may not be ready to move on just yet. Mike Florio Pushes Back on Puka Nacua Exit Rumors Before his off-field issues, the 25-year-old Nacua was on track to reset the receiver market with a record-breaking extension. Instead, he is playing out the final year of his four-year, $4.084 million rookie deal without long-term security as he approaches unrestricted free agency in March 2027. Fowler pointed to the injury, the suspension and the expiring contract as reasons the Rams may let him go. But Florio doesn’t think it’s that simple. Speaking on “Pro Football Talk,” he said the Rams still control Nacua’s contractual future. “Now, I saw that Jeremy Fowler of ESPN said that Puka Nacua’s time with the Rams is probably over. I think that’s premature because the Rams continue to hold his contractual rights until that contract expires,” Florio said. He added that Los Angeles has several ways to keep Nacua, including a new contract or the franchise tag. IMPROVE YOUR TEAM: PFN’s Free Fantasy Trade Calculator “And remember, the franchise tag is far lower than the current top of the market. George Pickens is at $27.298 million this year. In the abstract, it’s a lot of money. The top of the market is more than $42 million.” Florio believes Nacua would already have a deal like Jaxon Smith-Njigba’s four-year, $168.6 million extension, which pays $42.15 million per year, if not for his recent troubles. “So the Rams would only move on from Nacua if they don’t sign him to a new deal, if they don’t tag him, and then he goes out to the open market and no one offers him anything more than whatever the Rams were willing to offer,” he added. Is There Tension Between Nacua and the Rams? The contract situation is uncertain, and questions have also come up about Nacua’s relationship with the team after his knee injury. That wording raised questions about how involved the Rams were in the decision. The Rams first placed Nacua on injured reserve, hoping he could return for a playoff push. item.title: ‘He’s a distraction’ – NFL fans don’t have much sympathy for Puka Nacua after season-ending injury
item.description: Photo by Sean M. Haffey/Getty Images The LA Rams are set to lose Puka Nacua for the remainder of the NFL season, but fans believe the star WR isn’t worth the trouble for the franchise. Nacua had recently been handed a three-game suspension and a fine of nearly $1 million for a violation of the NFL’s personal code of conduct policy. However, his absence from the team is set to run all the way till the end of the season, as the star has undergone surgery. Puka Nacua’s injury draws mixed reactions from NFL fans According to NFL insider Adam Schefter, Puka Nacua is set to miss more time this season beyond his three-game suspension, as he underwent surgery to repair his MCL. As a result, he is expected to be out for four to five months, thus ruling him out for the remainder of the regular season, and possibly any playoff run the Rams make. Fans had drastically different reactions to the news of Nacua’s injury, with some criticising his recent trouble with the NFL, while others criticised Sean McVay for keeping Nacua in a game longer than needed, thus leading to his injury. One fan wrote: “Last snap as a Ram has been played. He’s a distraction and always injured.” Another fan added: “H*** of a way to spend a suspension.” A third fan pointed the finger at Sean McVay: “Hopefully that f****** jetsweep was worth it!” A fourth fan, however, praised the Rams for keeping Nacua away: “This is smart – he gets suspended; let’s just shut him down for the season so he can get the help he needs.” A fifth fan suggested Nacua’s suspension shouldn’t be overlooked because of his injury: “Doesn’t change the fact his three-game suspension should be enforced at the start of his return time.” And lastly, one final fan suggested Nacua will be healthy in time to join his next team: “Just in time for Raiders training camp.” Nacua’s injury absence is yet another blow to the Rams in a season where many felt they were the favourites to emerge from the NFC, given the strength of their roster. The Rams landed reigning DPOY Myles Garrett and coaxed Aaron Donald out of retirement in the offseason, thus adding to their already strong roster that was just one game away from going to the Super Bowl last season. However, their season has not gone the way they would have hoped, as the Rams have a 6-4 record and sit third in the NFC West behind the Seattle Seahawks and San Francisco 49ers. And with Nacua’s injury, the Rams’ offence is significantly weaker, thus putting their hopes of making it to the playoffs and trying to reach the Super Bowl in serious jeopardy. Read more: Rams learn devastating truth about Puka Nacua’s playoff return after surgery Colin Cowherd names the three NFL teams Puka Nacua should be thinking about joining ‘What a joke’ – Fans left furious as NFL confirm ‘lame’ details over Puka Nacua’s suspension

item.title: Ospreys legends set to turn out to honour Tipuric
item.description: Justin Tipuric gave up the Ospreys captaincy in 2024 with Jac Morgan taking over [Huw Evans Picture Agency] Welsh rugby fans will have a chance to pay tribute to Ospreys and Wales legend Justin Tipuric at St Helen's in Swansea on Sunday (14:30 GMT). An Ospreys legends vs Trebanos XV event will see Tipuric's only professional side take on his village club. The Ospreys legends squad includes former flanker Tipuric joined by fellow ex-Wales internationals Alun Wyn Jones, Shane Williams, James Hook, Richard Hibbard, Ian Gough, Scott Baldwin, Duncan Jones and Huw Bennett, while former back-rower and current Dragons head coach Filo Tiatia has also signed up. While Tipuric has been named in the Ospreys squad, he is expected to play for both sides. Tipuric lines ups among Ospreys legends Alun Wyn Jones and Justin Tipuric both retired from international rugby on the same day before the 2023 World Cup [Huw Evans Picture Agency] Tipuric retired at the end of the 2024-25 season to become Ospreys' defence coach. He was due to have a farewell home match at the old Swansea.com Stadium ground against Dragons in May 2025, but missed the match after picking up a pectoral injury against Lyon earlier that month. "There was a bit of a stick from a couple of the Trebanos guys saying they came down with a lot of the juniors to watch, but I wasn't even playing," said Tipuric. Ospreys have organised this occasion so fans can see Tipuric's famous blue scrum cap one more time on the rugby field. "The Ospreys said once we have our stadium done at St Helen's they wanted to make sure I had a game," added Tipuric. "Until I saw us kick off at St Helen's I didn't think I would see that happen because for the 20 years I've been involved, I've seen about five or six different plans. "I thought they had forgotten about it, so I didn't have to play, but they have been amazing with Richard Lancaster [Ospreys managing director] and so many people working behind the scenes." Shane Williams scored 58 tries in 87 internationals for Wales [Huw Evans Picture Agency] Modest man insists event is not about him The event does not have the Tipuric name in the title because the player himself was not keen on the spotlight. His insistence this is not labelled a testimonial match or a celebration of his career underlines how humble the flanker was during his playing days. Tipuric was always happier speaking about others than himself. His modesty off the field was matched by his brilliance on it. "It is definitely not about me, this is something for Ospreys, Trebanos and the fans," said Tipuric. "There are matches for the Trebanos juniors starting at 9am so they can get to play on the St Helen's pitch. "For the match itself, it will just be great to get people back in the building who have put an Ospreys jersey on during the last 20 years. "It's something we've never done before so that is quite special especially, hopefully, for the Ospreys fans, who have been amazing to me throughout my career."

item.title: Islanders 3, Red Wings 2: Palat pair overcomes post luck
item.description: A thousand games and a thousand hugs. | NHLI via Getty Images The Islanders banked another two points against an opponent they should beat, riding Ondrej Palat’s two goals to a 3-2 over the Red Wings in Detroit. Despite a good effort — certainly better than a couple nights ago in Winnipeg — it looked like things might not go their way when they were hitting posts (including Mathew Barzal, twice) while the Red Wings held a 1-0 lead thanks to a fortunate Joe Louis Little Caesar’s Whatever Arena end boards. But Palat scored midway through the second to tie it at 1-1, Simon Holmstrom finished off a broken 4-on-2 early i the third to give them the lead, and Ilya Sorokin made a sterling save to preserve the lead shortly before Palat extended it to 3-1. Alex DeBrincat, who is toiling away to honor his commitment to the Red Wings’ perpetual rebuild, scored his eighth of the season to make it close again with under seven minutes to go. Holmstrom’s goal, by the way, was his tenth. [ NHL Gamecenter | Game Summary | Event Summary | Natural Stat Trick ] It was a satisfying outcome for Casey Cizikas’ 1,000th regular season NHL game, complete with two goals from his fourth-line mate Palat. The 1,000 gamer also had a big shot block on Moritz Seider as time wound down to help seal the win. In addition to making a suite available for his family and friends who were in attendance, the Red Wings also gave him a Jumbotron salute during a TV stoppage. That drew a visit and embrace from Ben Chiarot, who fought Brayden Schenn a period later after the Wings defenseman roughed up Matthew Schaefer. (And that came after Chiarot got a roughing penalty for doing similar to Victor Eklund earlier in the period.) With the win, the Islanders keep pace in the wild card hunt, two points (27) behind current holders Florida (29), and with two games in hand. Up Next The Islanders return home to host the Leafs on Monday, the Blues on Wednesday and the Jets on Friday. Until then, find yourself someone who hugs you like Casey Cizikas hugs his victorious goalies.

There was plenty of excitement leading up to race day, especially after a wild qualifying session, and the drivers delivered. Max Verstappen and Red Bull Racing inherited the pole after Kimi Antonelli’s five-place penalty, while Antonelli’s Mercedes teammate, George Russell, started in second. item.title: Skyforce stay undefeated with sweep of Bulls
item.description: SIOUX FALLS, S.D. (SKYFORCE) --- The Sioux Falls Skyforce (6-0) erased a 16-point deficit and used a 43-point fourth quarter to defeat the Windy City Bulls (4-3) 128-119 on Saturday night in front of 2,683 fans at the Sanford Pentagon, completing a two-game weekend sweep. Miami HEAT two-way center Vladislav Goldin led Sioux Falls with 31 points on 12-14 shooting from the field, tying his season high while adding eight rebounds and three blocks. Guard Lester Quiñones matched Goldin with 31 points, knocking down three shots from beyond the arc and adding five rebounds and four assists. Quiñones has now scored 20 or more points in all six games this season. Windy City jumped out to an early advantage, building a 16-point lead in the opening quarter before taking a 31-24 advantage into the second. Sioux Falls responded with 30 points in the second period but trailed 60-54 at halftime. Sioux Falls narrowed the deficit to two points entering the fourth quarter after outscoring Windy City 31-27 in the third. The Skyforce took control down the stretch, completing the comeback with a dominant final period to secure their sixth consecutive victory. Miami HEAT two-way forward Keshad Johnson contributed 20 points, 10 rebounds and three steals for his first double-double of the season. Dennis Smith Jr. added 11 points and five assists off the bench, shooting 3-4 from three-point range. Sioux Falls shot 51.3 percent from the field, finishing 40-78 overall and 26-28 from the free-throw line while recording 22 assists and 56 points in the paint. Jaylin Sellers led Windy City with a game-high 36 points, while Orlando Robinson added 20 points and eight rebounds. Tobe Awaka contributed 18 points and 12 rebounds, and Drew Peterson finished with 16 points and nine assists. The Skyforce continue their homestand on Wednesday, November 25, when they host the Cleveland Charge at 6:30 p.m. CST at the Sanford Pentagon. The game will air on NBA.com, the NBA App and MIDCO1. item.title: Luka Doncic’s injury nightmare has Austin Reaves taking extra precautions with Lakers
item.description: Photo by Luke Hales/Getty Images Luka Doncic has urged Austin Reaves to take his time recovering from a heel injury after revealing how a similar problem once affected his own career. The Los Angeles Lakers are waiting for Reaves to return from a left heel bruise, with the guard currently being monitored on a day-to-day basis. Doncic has experienced the same issue before and is keen to ensure his teammate does not make the mistake of rushing back too soon. Luka Doncic warns Austin Reaves after previous heel injury setback According to ESPN’s Dave McMenamin , Doncic personally shared his experience with Reaves and explained why he should prioritise his long-term fitness. A source close to the Lakers star revealed the message Doncic delivered: “I’ve dealt with a bruised heel back in 2024, and it led to a calf strain, which ultimately led to me being traded from the Dallas Mavericks to the Lakers. We don’t want you to be in a similar situation. We’re trying to be in this for the long haul. Take your time now – we’re 13-3, and we’ll hold down the fort.” Doncic’s warning comes from personal experience, having seen his heel problem develop into a calf strain before his eventual move from Dallas to Los Angeles. Meanwhile, Reaves’ recovery has reportedly been progressing positively. McMenamin revealed that the guard had returned to the court for a workout, although the Lakers were prepared to remain cautious with his comeback. He added that Reaves had been improving day by day and that the team recognised the value of giving him additional rest before its next game. Quentin Grimes has stepped up in Reaves’ absence, but the Lakers have had some uncomfortable moments without one of their key offensive options. They suffered an upset defeat to Utah and were pushed hard by Charlotte and Sacramento before securing narrow victories. Los Angeles did manage to beat the Kings 106-104, with Doncic recording 25 points, eight assists and four rebounds. With the Lakers sitting at 14-3, Doncic clearly believes there is no reason to risk Reaves’ fitness for an immediate return. The priority is having him available for the longer campaign. item.title: Kirby Smart leads Georgia to SEC history with win over South Carolina
item.description: Geoff Burke-Imagn Images Kirby Smart leads Georgia to SEC history with win over South Carolina appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . Kirby Smart ’s Georgia football teams have dominated the SEC for this entire decade, and on Saturday, they made history. With their dominant 34-6 win over South Carolina, the Bulldogs became the first team to reach six straight SEC championship games . GEORGIA IS THE FIRST TEAM IN SEC HISTORY TO MAKE IT TO SIX STRAIGHT SEC CHAMPIONSHIPS 🔥 pic.twitter.com/bELRTDaiGV — SEC Network (@SECNetwork) November 22, 2026 Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Georgia has ended conference play at 8-1, with a four-game win streak against four ranked teams. The Bulldogs await their opponent in the SEC title game, as three teams (Texas, Tennessee, and Alabama) are currently tied at 6-2. Georgia’s win over South Carolina was another outstanding performance on both sides of the ball. Starting quarterback Gunner Stockton was an efficient 19-of-23 for 281 yards. Running back Nate Frazier had 94 yards and two touchdowns. And the defense limited South Carolina quarterback LaNorris Sellers to just 87 passing yards with no touchdowns. It’s the third time during their four-game win streak that the Bulldogs D has limited its opponent to single-digit scoring. Since Smart’s arrival at Georgia in 2016, the Bulldogs have been in the SEC title game nine out of 11 years, which is an incredible mark of consistency. The Bulldogs have gone just 4-4 in the SEC championship game under Smart, although they’ve won each of the last two. This year, the Bulldogs are looking unstoppable. As Kirk Herbstreit suggested , the Auburn loss might have woken them up as they’ve been outstanding on both sides of the ball since. Not only are they well on course for a third-straight SEC championship game win, but they are also the clear team to beat in the upcoming College Football Playoff. item.title: Stampede drop dramatic showdown to Black Hawks
item.description: WATERLOO, I.A. (STAMPEDE) — Saturday night was made for hockey, and it was expectedly a chippy game from the start, with the Stampede entering the game short a forward already. The bench would continue to shrink throughout the night. 38 seconds into the game, Sioux Falls captain Cooper Soller (goalie interference) and Waterloo's Keegan Davis (cross checking) would take matching penalties. 35 seconds into the penalties, James Russell would pick up his first of the night and first of the season. His second would come 2:26 later, putting the Black Hawks up 2-0 early. At the 3:09 mark, Sioux Falls forward Matthew Portz would be called for roughing while Waterloo would have Jordan Geike called for slashing. During the stoppage, the Stampede would see Cruz Waltze drop the Gloves with Keegan Davis, with both receiving a fighting major and a game misconduct. With four seconds remaining in the first period, Colin Dustin would add to the Waterloo lead, ending the period 3-0 in favor of the Black Hawks. In total, the first period would result in 89 minutes of penalties between the two teams, and forward Ryder Betzold would not return to the game after going down behind the Waterloo net. 10:47 into the second period, Portz would get the Herd on the board with his fourth of the season with a quick shot while on a rush with Pavel Martinu. Dustin would restore the three-goal lead for the Black Hawks 2:10 later, with goaltender Charlie Menard picking up a secondary assist. With 3:03 remaining in the middle frame, Trevor O'Donohue would pick up a power-play goal for the home team to make it a 5-1 Waterloo lead through 40 minutes. The middle frame would see another 31 minutes of penalties, with Stampede defenseman Michael Bonkov being sent off for a cross-checking major and game misconduct, shortening the Stampede bench even further with 4:19 to go. The third period is where everything went right for the Stampede and where everything went wonky for the Stampede. Soller (TBL) picked up his 15th goal of the season, his first of the night, on the power play, shoveling home the puck behind Menard's right pad 7:57 into the period. 2:08 later, Ethan Sung (2027) would pick up a stretch pass from defenseman Noah Mannausau while shorthanded, with a perfect shot from the face-off circle. Soller would draw the Herd within one, scoring on the same penalty as Sung, just 56 seconds later with a seeing-eye shot over Menard's right shoulder. Unfortunately for the Herd, penalties to Drew Botts (2027) and Markus Jakobsen late in the game would prove too much for the Stampede to overcome, with Caleb Deanovich making it a 6-4 game while on the 5-on-3, and Hayden Russell adding the final dagger with his own power-play tally with 1:09 to go. Stampede netminder Ryan Cameron (EDM) stopped 8-of-11 shots in the first period before being relieved by Ilya Nikitins (2027) for the rest of the game. item.title: We focus on things that matter to Edo; I’m ready to supervise execution of convicted kidnappers — Okpebholo
item.description: By Ozioruva Aliu GOVERNOR Monday Okpebholo just celebrated his administration’s second year anniversary in Edo State. In this interview with some editors in his office in Benin-City, Okpebholo speaks about his administration’s commitment to good governance for the people and how he wants to leave the state among other issues. How do you assess your administration so far? Construction is ongoing all over the state. Road construction is ongoing. Schools are being constructed. Also construction is ongoing in the primary healthcare area, we are also doing marvelously well in that sector. There are many areas that have been neglected in the past where you can’t even remember that roads ever existed in some of these places but we are working there. I can remember vividly that when you were coming from Abuja, from Auchi, then Ewu to Ekpoma, that road was completely washed off. I spoke to the Minister of Works to please allow me do this work so that I could be reimbursed. He approved it and talked to Mr. President and Mr. President agreed that I should do it and then forward the bill, we are already on that road. I really don’t talk much because I know I am saving my energy to work. For me, talking is not the business, working is the business. So I prefer doing the job than talking so that when you come you see. When they are crying, shouting on social media, it doesn’t bother me because the people that live in those areas know that work is ongoing. We are also working in the villages because there are also human beings there and they also contribute to the economy. If they don’t go to the farm, where will you see food to eat and when you don’t eat, there will be hostility. That is the truth and that is why I feel that everybody should be carried along. There are villages that you never think of, I will just go there and do my work. I don’t need any politician to lobby me. I don’t need any influencer to lobby me, all I need to do is just to do the will and the wish of the people. Is it the policy of the state government now that your roads will be concrete pavement? We are not only just doing the concrete pavement, one of the reasons we are doing it is because of the swampy nature of many of our areas. We are in the rainforest zone and we need to sustain the roads. We have carefully studied to see that without concrete pavement, we will have problems within a short time. We are preparing for the future so that by the time when this government leaves, the next government will come and concentrate on other areas so that development will spread. Look, we are not only working on infrastructure, we are also working on security. We are trying to make Edo very safe, safer than we met it. When we came in, within a week I recorded about 11 people dead not in an accident, somebody will get into a shop and kill the person there, somebody will just see someone on the road and shoot him. Why? The killers were cultists. I remember when the BBC guys came here and asked

item.title: APOD: 2026 November 22 – Swirls and Colors on Jupiter from Juno
item.description: APOD Science APOD APOD: 2026 November 22 –… Today’s APOD Archive Submissions Index Search Calendar RSS Education About Discuss APOD Astronomy Picture of the Day Discover the cosmos! Each day a different image or photograph of our fascinating universe is featured, along with a brief explanation written by a professional astronomer. Swirls and Colors on Jupiter from Juno Explanation: What creates the colors in Jupiter’s clouds? No one is sure. The thick atmosphere of Jupiter is mostly hydrogen and helium , elements which are colorless at the low temperatures of the Jovian cloud tops . Which trace molecules provide the colors remains a topic of research , although small amounts of ammonium hydrosulfide are one leading candidate . What is clear from the featured color-enhanced image — and many similar images — is that lighter clouds are typically higher up than darker ones. Pictured, light clouds swirl around reddish regions toward the lower right, while they appear to cover over some darker domains on the upper right. The featured image was taken by the robotic Juno spacecraft in 2018 during its 14th low pass over Jupiter . Juno continues in its looping elliptical orbit, swooping near the huge planet every 33 days and exploring a slightly different sector each time around. item.title: Trouble in House of God: Single-founder churches spark succession storm
item.description: By Ebunoluwa Sessou & Nnamdi Ojiego The leadership dispute at the Fountain of Life Church, Lagos, following the death of its founder, Pastor Taiwo Odukoya, has brought a difficult question facing many founder-led churches into public focus: Who takes charge when the person around whom a ministry was built is no longer there? The disagreement over the position of his son, Pastor Jimmy Odukoya, has moved from the church’s internal leadership structure to the courts, with competing claims over the late founder’s wishes, the church’s constitution and the authority of its Board of Trustees. On November 17, a faction of the church’s trustees announced that Jimmy was no longer recognised as senior pastor. The trustees said their decision followed a review of the church’s succession arrangements and a video recording made by the late Taiwo Odukoya in December 2021, in which he allegedly named Pastor Kunle Areogun as his preferred successor. Odukoya’s wife, Pastor Bimbo, a co-founder of the church, had earlier died in a plane crash. According to the trustees, the late founder proposed that Jimmy serve as Areogun’s administrative assistant and head of the church’s youth ministry. They said the recording was made available to them in December 2025 and was not presented when Jimmy was appointed senior pastor in September 2023. The trustees subsequently named Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as interim spiritual and administrative leader, pending consultations and the establishment of a substantive leadership structure. Controversy over remarriage The dispute came on the heels of Jimmy’s recent remarriage, which the trustees identified as one of their concerns about his continued leadership of the church. Jimmy introduced his new wife, Mo Jasyme, to the congregation during a Sunday service on November 1, 2026, describing her as his wife and the church’s new first lady. The union was publicly blessed by Pastor Tunde Bakare, founder of the Citadel Global Community Church, who prayed for the couple during the service. The marriage followed the end of Jimmy’s previous union with Oluwakemi Banjoko, whom he married in London in March 2013. The couple have two children. The circumstances surrounding the breakdown of that marriage have not been publicly established. During the introduction of his new wife, Jimmy said his first marriage had ended before he became senior pastor in September 2023. The trustees, however, described the remarriage and its public blessing as contrary to the church’s teachings, the values of its founders and the standards expected of its spiritual leadership. They said the development had caused distress among members and brought the church into public controversy and disrepute. Their statement placed the marriage alongside the disagreement over the succession recording as grounds for their action against him. The trustees subsequently named Pastor Rotimi Okpaise as interim spiritual and administrative leader, pending consultations and the establishmen

item.description: •Stakeholders warn of threat to democracy, ask candidates to rein in supporters By Henry Umoru, John Alechenu, Luminous Jannamike & Deola Badru In the build up to the 2027 general elections increasingly characterised by attacks on supporters of political parties, destruction of campaign materials, intimidation and allegations of political thuggery, opposition parties and the ruling All Progressives Congress, APC, have traded accusations over who is responsible for the growing violence. The political atmosphere across the country 55 days to the polls is becoming increasingly charged, with fears that the situation could deteriorate further in the coming days if political leaders fail to rein in their supporters and caution their members against inflammatory statements and actions. The APC had accused opposition parties of sponsoring violence and hiring thugs to disrupt political activities, particularly following the incident involving President Bola Tinubu during his visit to a mosque in Abuja for prayers. Sponsoring violence It claimed the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) are sponsoring violence, spreading misinformation and recruiting young Nigerians to disrupt its presidential campaign activities ahead of the 2027 general elections. Dr Dele Alake, spokesperson for the APC Presidential Campaign Council, made the allegations in a statement against the backdrop of recent attacks and confrontations involving political parties and their supporters nationwide. The statement came days after suspected political thugs disrupted an NDC town hall meeting in Ikeja, Lagos, on November 12, where the party’s presidential candidate, Peter Obi, was expected to address supporters. “To create the false narrative of citizens’ discontent against the President, the ADC and NDC now sponsor hoodlums, arm them with cudgels and banners, and commandeer them to chant ‘Bamaiyi’ at APC campaign rallies,” the statement said. “The latest instance of this abhorrent and anti-democratic stunt was the desecration of an Abuja Mosque last Friday, where these thugs were mobilised to pelt the presidential motorcade with stones. “Also concerning is how our party’s campaign billboards are being destroyed under cover of night by opposition-sponsored agents. This is unacceptable and antithetical to democratic ideals,” the campaign council added. “Again, we call on the ADC and NDC leaders to stop the dangerous conscription of ignorant young Nigerians for unwholesome political activities that put their lives at risk, while those leaders’ own children luxuriate in splendour abroad”.
